description: This file defines the `GatewayConnectionController` class responsible for managing WebSocket connections to gateways, handling discovery, TLS verification, auto-reconnect logic, and related network resolution tasks within an iOS app.

classes.name: GatewayTLSFingerprintProbe
classes.description: A helper class for probing TLS fingerprints of a server's SSL certificate over a WebSocket connection, used to verify TLS identities.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a discovered gateway, resolving service endpoints and handling TLS fingerprint verification.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a discovered gateway asynchronously.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Initiates a manual connection to a specified host and port, handling TLS verification if needed.

methods.name: connectLastKnown
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect to the last known gateway based on saved settings.

methods.name: refreshActiveGatewayRegistrationFromSettings
methods.description: Rebuilds and reapplies the current gateway connection configuration based on local settings.

methods.name: clearPendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Clears any pending TLS trust prompts.

methods.name: acceptPendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Accepts the current TLS trust prompt and proceeds with connection.

methods.name: declinePendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Declines the current TLS trust prompt.

methods.name: updateFromDiscovery
methods.description: Updates the list of gateways and related status from gateway discovery component.

methods.name: observeDiscovery
methods.description: Sets up observation to update state when discovery information changes.

methods.name: maybeAutoConnect
methods.description: Attempts to auto-connect to a gateway based on preferences and recent discovery.

methods.name: updateLastDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Sets the last discovered gateway ID in persistent storage, if appropriate.

methods.name: startAutoConnect
methods.description: Initiates the process to establish a gateway connection with provided parameters.

methods.name: resolveDiscoveredTLSParams
methods.description: Determines the TLS parameters based on a discovered gateway and stored fingerprint.

methods.name: resolveManualTLSParams
methods.description: Determines the TLS parameters for manual connection attempts based on stored pin and configuration.

methods.name: probeTLSFingerprint
methods.description: Probes the server for its TLS fingerprint asynchronously.

methods.name: resolveServiceEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves a service endpoint (e.g., via DNS-SD or similar) to host and port.

methods.name: resolveHostPortFromBonjourEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves a Bonjour (zeroconf) endpoint to host and port.

methods.name: buildGatewayURL
methods.description: Constructs a WebSocket URL with correct scheme (ws/wss) from host, port, and TLS flag.

methods.name: resolveManualUseTLS
methods.description: Determines whether to use TLS for manual connections based on configuration and host.

methods.name: shouldRequireTLS
methods.description: Decides if TLS is required based on host (non-loopback hosts).

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Checks if a given hostname represents a loopback address or hostname.

methods.name: manualStableID
methods.description: Generates a stable identifier string for a manual host:port pair.

methods.name: makeConnectOptions
methods.description: Creates connection options including capabilities, commands, permissions, and identification.
